message: which name(s) nothing of their own
$reason: A group named by the consumer around two self-named texts and a note made an editing host by `[contentEditable]` — the property, as a property binding has to name it: the compiler maps no `[contenteditable]` onto it, and its DOM schema knows no property of that name on a `<div>`. The gate's list held `[contenteditable]` and `[attr.contenteditable]`, so the note was no control to it and the group carried the name over a field that names nothing, 0090's E3 by another element. A bound `contenteditable` is one key now, whatever the syntax.
